rows.name: closure_ids
rows.source:
var saved=()=>0
let a=attempt(()=>{fn escaped()=>1/0
saved=escaped
fail("save")})
let b=attempt(saved)
assert(b.error.traceback[-1].func=="escaped")
fn later()=>9
assert(attempt(later).value==9)
